users.title: Users
users.onlyBaseRole: Only holds {role}, the baseline every member has.

users.pending: Their next sign-in adds: {items}. Their Authentik groups have changed since the row was written.
users.payoutFailed: Could not look up account details.
users.noGrants: No personal access. Everything above comes from the groups in Authentik.
users.removeGrantBody: {what} is removed right away. What the groups give is not affected.

mailbox.notConnected: Not connected. No mail is read until someone logs in as {address}.

result.denied: The login was cancelled. The inbox is not connected.

result.wrongMailbox: You logged in with the wrong account. Log in as the inbox address.

result.failed: The inbox could not be connected. Try again.

mailbox.unconfigured: Gmail is not configured on the server (the GMAIL_ variables are not set, see docs/gmail-inbound.md). No mail is read.
